# Segment

Twilio Segment is a customer data platform that helps businesses collect, clean, and control their customer data.

Category: Data. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/segment/.

## Actions

- **Batch Segment Analytics Events** (read-only): Send multiple analytics calls in a single batch request.
- **Delete Source**: Delete a Segment Source.
- **Segment Alias**: Alias a previous user ID to a new user ID.
- **Segment Group**: Associate an identified user with a group via Segment HTTP Tracking API.
- **Segment Identify**: Identify a user and set/update traits via Segment HTTP Tracking API.
- **Segment Page View**: Record a page view via Segment HTTP Tracking API.
- **Segment Screen Event**: Record a mobile app screen view.
- **Segment Track Event**: Record a custom user event via Segment HTTP Tracking API.
- **Update Source**: Update a Source's metadata and settings.
- **Add Labels to Source**: Add existing labels to a Source.
- **Get Daily Per Source API Calls Usage** (read-only): Fetch daily API call counts per source for a given period.
- **Get Destination** (read-only): Retrieve a Destination by ID.
- **List Connected Warehouses From Source** (read-only): List warehouses connected to a Source.
- **List Delivery Metrics Summary from Destination** (read-only): Get an event delivery metrics summary from a Destination.
- **List Schema Settings in Source** (read-only): Retrieve schema configuration settings for a Source.
- **Remove Source Write Key**: Remove a write key from a Source.
